# Grubenhauer Spawns: All locations including a map

![Grubenhauer Spawns: All locations including map](/uploads/747_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Important:**If you are looking for treasure hunters, use our treasure hunter map. The Miner spawns do not match the Treasure Hunter spawns. Treasure hunters can spawn in significantly more locations.

**Mine Hewers** are a mutated form of humans that make their home in the many caves, mines, and quarries of Appalachia. Trapped in their worn-out suits, they attack anything they see as a threat.

In the "**Rusty Pick**" there is a unique Miner named **Supplier Murmrgh** who sells random legendary weapons, armor, vault steel, and legendary modules.

The first miners existed in **Welch** and were exploited for expertise by the Enclave's research unit before its collapse in 2086.

The reason for their degeneration is unclear, it could be radiation or the toxic air in Ash Heap. Or both. However, this effect is so strong that they cannot breathe normally without their Filter-O-Matic ventilators.

![Grubenhauer](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20260705-12-10-36.jpg)

With the exception of the supplier Murmrgh, all pit hewers are very aggressive and carry shotguns, assault rifles, rocket launchers and improvised weapons to attack their opponents. They also use mole rats equipped with landmines.

Until 2102 they could still be found in Lucky Hole Mine, but in 2103 they were pushed out of there by Mottenmann cultists.

In 2104, Mine Hewers also served the **Ultracite Titan**, a gigantic mole rat under Ash Heap, and they also attack the **Tunnel of Love** in Nuka World on tour.
